scope: 115 primary HCC tumors only; exclude 52 adjacent tissues from projection and cutoff
reference: Frozen original 850x17 v4 weighted NNLS; intersect measured genes, no marker tuning
expression: Use published RSN-normalized linear-scale microarray signals; never exponentiate. Collapse unambiguous official probes per gene by median; clip negative gene signals to zero; normalize sum of all mapped genes to 10000.
negative_signal_sensitivity: Keep original signed signals as a mathematical projection sensitivity, using same NNLS and own outcome-independent tumor median; do not interpret signed query as RNA concentration.
grouping: Global median across all 115 tumor expression samples before endpoint exclusions; High>median, Low<=median
endpoints: OS and source RFS in years converted to months (x12); explicit event labels 0/1; missing RFS not imputed
endpoint_QC: Finite positive time, binary event; exclude RFS follow-up beyond recorded known death (HCC29); retain original times without correction
models: Unadjusted High-vs-Low and per-all115-SD continuous Cox; supplementary age/sex adjustment. Stage not included because only23 OS deaths and additional stage parameters would increase overfitting.
multiple_testing: BH across OS/RFS primary logrank tests; separately across 8 target-coefficient Cox tests (2 endpoints x4 models)
